name: blather
description: Local-only composer for publishing to X, Bluesky, Threads, and Instagram

scripts.dev: bun run electron:compile && bun run electron:rebuild && electron .
scripts.build: bun run node:rebuild && bun run electron:compile && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && bun run electron:rebuild && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.build:dir: bun run node:rebuild && bun run electron:compile && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build && bun run electron:rebuild && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.test:e2e: bun run electron:compile && bun run electron:rebuild && playwright test
